basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old fantasy enthusiast living in Portland, Oregon. By day, I work as a software developer, but by night, I'm diving into fantastical worlds through books, games, and discussions online. My interests range from epic fantasy novels to indie video games, particularly those with rich storylines. I’m always on the lookout for unique storytelling angles, especially those that subvert traditional tropes. I dislike spoilers and prefer to explore stories without preconceived notions. I usually browse Reddit during evenings and weekends when I have free time. Currently, I'm single, and I enjoy spending my free time playing guitar and trading in online gaming communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a degree from Oregon State University. I've been an avid reader since my teens, which has fueled my passion for fantasy literature. Over the years, I've developed a broad knowledge of fantasy and sci-fi genres through self-study and active engagement in discussions both online and offline. I'm also a self-taught guitarist, often sharing tips and tricks on subreddits related to music.
